hold_it:cool_shape.desc: Creates a powerful containment field that charges over time. Visual effects show sphere boundaries on block surfaces.
hold_it:cool_shape.desc.magnitude: Controls the intensity of magical effect (0.5-1.0). Higher values create more powerful impacts.
hold_it:cool_shape.desc.radius: Determines sphere size in blocks (5-20). Larger radius requires longer charging time.
hold_it:awesome_shape.desc: Creates multiple independent magical spheres from ancient projectile group creation techniques.
hold_it:awesome_shape.desc.magnitude: Number and power of energy orbs created (1-10). Each orb operates with semi-autonomous intelligence.
hold_it:awesome_shape.desc.precision: Coordination and targeting accuracy (0-2). Perfect precision creates devastating synchronized attacks.
hold_it:seven_shape.desc: Condenses mana into a solid vortex that explodes with powerful pulse, with selective targeting capabilities.
hold_it:seven_shape.desc.magnitude: Power of the vortex explosion (1-100). Determines the intensity of the delayed effect.
hold_it:seven_shape.desc.radius: Size of the vortex area in blocks (1-4). Compact radius perfect for precise applications.
hold_it:seven_shape.desc.delay: Time in seconds before automatic activation (1-10). Timing is everything for effective use.
hold_it:big_ball_shape.desc: Forms substantial and stable projectiles with high arcane density but reduced velocity.
hold_it:big_ball_shape.desc.magnitude: Size and power of the projectile. Higher values create larger area of effect upon impact.
hold_it:big_ball_shape.desc.velocity: Speed of the projectile. Arcane density comes at the cost of velocity - time casting carefully.
hold_it:portal_sword_shape.desc: Tears reality's fabric to forge swords of pure arcana delivered through dimensional rifts.
hold_it:portal_sword_shape.desc.magnitud: Number and power of spectral blades (1-30). Each blade operates with targeting intelligence.
hold_it:portal_sword_shape.desc.duration: How long the portals remain active (1-30 seconds). Longer duration means more sustained assault.
hold_it:portal_sword_shape.desc.speed: Velocity of the arcane blades (0.1-5.0). Faster blades are harder to evade.
hold_it.charging.tip: Hold the cast button to charge spell power. Longer charging yields exponentially greater effects.
hold_it.charging.formula: Mana cost scales with attributes. Portal Sword formula: 0.5 × Magnitude × Speed × √Duration
hold_it.charging.warning: Premature release reduces effectiveness. Interruption wastes mana and leaves caster vulnerable.
hold_it:pork_warrior.desc.delay: A delay in seconds before applying this component.
hold_it:pork_warrior.desc.duration: How long the pork warrior will last.
hold_it:pork_pulse.desc.delay: A delay in seconds before applying this component.
hold_it:pork_pulse.desc.radius: How large the pulse is to target dropped pork chops.
